Commercial Offer - Muminjon - Anarita BESS

Executive Summary

Lighthief Cyprus Ltd is pleased to present this commercial offer to Muminjon for two fully bankable, turnkey Battery Energy Storage Systems (BESS) at the Anarita site in Paphos District — one system per park (East and West). Each system uses Linyang Power Atlantic LFP battery containers with Kehua C-series grid-following/grid-forming PCS inverters (TÜV-certified EN 50549-2). The price includes equipment, installation, commissioning, and delivery to site (DAP Anarita).

Note: Pricing assumes standard ground conditions; site-specific ground works and levelling are excluded. DSO grid connection works, if required, are not included.

Why 2 × 5/15 MWh (Split Configuration):
  • Each park (East + West) gets its own independent BESS — no single point of failure
  • Curtailed energy is captured locally at each substation — shorter cable runs, lower losses
  • Independent operation: each system can be maintained without affecting the other
  • Same 30 MWh total capacity and 3-hour duration as the single-system option
  • Each MV SKID connects directly to the park's existing 22 kV switchgear

C-Series PCS — Grid-Following & Grid-Forming Ready
The Kehua BCS1250K-C-HUD is the latest-generation C-series inverter with a built-in grid-forming controller. In standard operation, the PCS runs in grid-following mode, synchronising to the existing grid signal. When required, it can seamlessly transition to grid-forming mode (Virtual Synchronous Generator), providing voltage and frequency support, black-start capability, and island operation. This dual-mode capability future-proofs the installation for upcoming Cyprus TSO grid code requirements and enhances ancillary service revenue potential. TÜV-certified to EN 50549-2:2019/A1:2023 (certificate D 115067 0077).

Muminjon - Scope of Supply & Timeline

Scope of Supply

✅ INCLUDED IN EPC PRICE

  • Battery Containers - Complete with LFP cells, BMS, HVAC, fire suppression
  • Power Conversion Systems - Kehua PCS units with grid-forming capability
  • MV SKID - Transformer, switchgear, protection systems
  • Auxiliary Transformer - For HVAC and BMS power
  • RTU - Remote Terminal Unit for DSO communication
  • Shipping & Transport - CIF Limassol + inland delivery to site
  • Import Duties & Customs - Clearance and handling
  • Inland Transport - Port to site delivery
  • Concrete Foundations - Reinforced per Κ.Δ.Π. 15/2026 (assumes level ground*)
  • DC Cabling - Up to 50m per container
  • AC/MV Cabling - LV and MV connections
  • MV Terminations - Connection to grid
  • Protection Engineering - Settings and coordination
  • SCADA Programming - IEC 60870-5-104 integration
  • Remote Trip System - DSO emergency disconnect
  • Commissioning - Full system commissioning
  • Insurance - CAR/EAR during construction
  • OEM Supervision - Linyang/Kehua engineer support
  • Base Warranty - 5 years equipment warranty

❌ CLIENT RESPONSIBILITY

  • CERA License - Generation license application
  • DSO Application - EAC connection agreement
  • DSO/EAC Fees - Connection fees, network charges
  • External Lightning Protection - If required by site assessment
  • Telecoms Backhaul - Internet/4G connectivity (OPEX)
  • Site Fencing - Perimeter security
  • Planning Permits - If required for site
  • Land - Site lease or purchase
  • Grid Upgrades - If required by DSO
  • Water Drainage - If special works required (€1,500)
  • Ground Works & Leveling - Beyond standard scope (clearing, grading, excavation)
  • Access Roads - If not existing or requiring upgrade
* Ground Conditions Assumption: Pricing assumes reasonably level, stable ground suitable for standard foundations. Any site-specific ground works including but not limited to: land clearing, vegetation removal, grading, leveling, rock breaking, soil stabilization, or special drainage are not included and will be quoted separately upon site survey if required.

Bankability & Investor Protection

This project is structured to meet the requirements of project financiers, lending institutions, and institutional investors. All contractual protections use fixed, auditable formulae with no discretionary elements.

Protection Detail
Performance Bond 5% corporate bank guarantee from Linyang Energy (Shanghai-listed, revenue >US$3B)
Delay Liquidated Damages Fixed rate: 0.1–0.2% of contract value per day, capped at 10%. Accrual starts after agreed milestone dates (shipping & DSO delays excluded)
SOH Liquidated Damages If SOH falls below guaranteed curve: shortfall MWh × €30/MWh/day. 90-day remedy grace period before LD accrual
Availability Guarantee 97% annual system availability. Shortfall compensated via defined LD mechanism
EPC Insurance CAR/EAR + Third Party Liability during construction. Marine cargo covered by OEM (CIF terms)
OEM Certifications TÜV-certified EN 50549-2 grid code compliance; IEC 62619 battery safety; UN38.3 transport certification
Equipment Warranty 5-year base warranty (included). Extendable to 15 years via OEM contract at confirmed rates
Local O&M Presence Lighthief Cyprus service team (6 field engineers), spare parts warehouse in Limassol, 24/7 remote monitoring via Voltus SCADA

End-of-Life Management

Included at no additional cost: At end of BESS operational life, Lighthief Cyprus Ltd will:
  • Collect and transport batteries at no cost to client
  • Assess residual value for second-life or recycling
  • Provide cashback based on EOL market value, OR
  • Recycle at net zero cost to client
